decisive_items: a radiological diagnosis of juvenile ossifying fibroma of the right posterior maxilla was made
the margin of the swelling was well-defined and well demarcated from the surrounding areas which was very much unlike FD whose margin is ill-defined and merges with the surrounding areas
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms and radiographic findings are consistent with juvenile ossifying fibroma, and the well-defined margin of the swelling makes fibrous dysplasia less likely

rejected.why: The margin of the swelling was well-defined, which is not typical of fibrous dysplasia
